name: Finnish Lapland
about: Nov–Dec is peak Christmas-tourism season, while the best Northern Lights viewing runs Sept–Mar. Summer (Jun–Jul) flips to 24-hour midnight sun, and husky/reindeer sledding gives way to hiking.
overview: Rovaniemi's Santa Claus Village sits right on the Arctic Circle, with husky and reindeer sledding, Northern Lights, and genuine Arctic wilderness.
costOverview: Everyday costs in Finnish Lapland are moderate, but the reindeer and husky experiences that define a trip here are genuine splurges most visitors budget specifically for.

stargazing.label: Aurora season (dark enough to see it)

specialSeasons.text: Peak Christmas-tourism season at Santa Claus Village, on the Arctic Circle just outside Rovaniemi.
The sun doesn't set at all this far north — 24-hour daylight and mild hiking weather.
